data.name: help.start.body
data.value:
Open a page from the left navigation. Opening it again selects the existing tab. Ctrl+W closes the current tab; F5 refreshes supported pages; Ctrl+F focuses page search. F1 opens help for the current page.
The File menu has recent pages. The Window menu can favorite the current page. The View menu shows or hides navigation and the details/tasks panel, and resets layout. Resetting layout keeps open pages and favorites.
Unsaved changes require Save, Discard or Cancel before closing. A failed save keeps the input. Do not delete the database to resolve an error.

data.name: help.settings.body
data.value:
Theme and interface density apply after they are saved. Language, regional format, time zone and log retention require a restart. Regional format is independent of display language. Stored timestamps remain UTC.
Changes may require permission or production confirmation. Failed or cancelled changes restore the previous settings. Remote health checks are disabled by default; a successful check verifies only the configured health endpoint. Sign-in requires administrator identity configuration and a working system credential store.

data.name: help.backup.body
data.value:
Create a ZIP backup before upgrades or major changes. It contains a consistent local database copy, user settings, workspace preferences and a SHA-256 manifest. Deployment identity configuration and credentials are excluded.
Preview the backup and confirm the listed content before scheduling restore. Restore replaces database and preferences on the next startup and keeps safety copies. Old backups without workspace preferences reset the layout. Raw database files are not accepted.
If upgrade or restore fails, keep the original files and logs. Do not delete migration history or overwrite the database manually. Ask the administrator to follow the supplied upgrade guide.

data.name: help.diagnostics.body
data.value:
Open the task panel to inspect imports and exports while keeping the business page open. Cancellation is a request: a commit that already succeeded remains successful. View task opens the full diagnostic record. Closing a page does not stop its global task.
TASK_FAILED: inspect the task result and correlation ID in the log before retrying; avoid repeating an operation whose result is uncertain.
UI_UNEXPECTED: an unexpected interface error was logged. Keep the error code and correlation ID. If it recurs, restart safely and contact support. Original exceptions are not shown in the error dialog.
Diagnostic export requires a preview and explicit confirmation. Only the listed, sanitized metadata is included; diagnostic files are not uploaded automatically.

data.name: help.logs.body
data.value:
Select technical, task or security audit events, then filter by time, level, module, task ID, error code or correlation ID. The warnings/errors preset includes technical and task events. Clear filters returns to technical logs. Use the copy buttons for details or correlation IDs.
When authentication is enabled, technical/task events require logs:read and audit requires audit:read. Opening shared log folders requires both; cleanup also requires settings:manage and production confirmation. Account changes or lost access clear old results; reload after access is restored.
Cleanup uses configured retention. Diagnostic packages exclude audit events and require diagnostics:export, plus logs:read when including logs. Review exports before sharing; do not send the entire data directory.

data.name: help.version.body
data.value:
The help header and About page show the installed application version. About can check the administrator-configured HTTPS update feed. When an update is available, review the version and address, then choose Open download address to open it in your default browser. The application does not install updates automatically. Checking again clears the old download entry; closing About cancels its check.
Help → Third-party license notices displays the THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md shipped with this build. The same entry is available from About. Development builds may not include this file. Its absence does not mean there are no third-party dependencies or that release compliance passed.

data.name: help.demo.body
data.value:
Select a record to edit it in the standard form. Ctrl+N creates a record; Ctrl+S saves; Cancel discards through the unsaved-changes prompt. Code and name are required. A version conflict requires preserving your input and reloading the current record.
CSV import: choose encoding, delimiter and source column mapping, inspect the preview, then confirm. The preview is limited to 20 data rows; full validation happens before committing. Maximum input is 5000 rows and 5 MiB. A changed file requires a new preview. Validation errors prevent the whole import and can be exported as a report.
Export uses the current search condition. Imports and exports continue in the task centre if the page closes. Refresh the list after completion.

data.name: help.spreadsheet.body
data.value:
The optional XLSX page handles bounded plain-text tables, up to 5000 rows and 5 MiB for import. Preview and confirm the validated content before importing. Formulas, macros, external relationships and non-text cells are rejected.
Cancelling preview or closing the page stops the local preview. A started import or export belongs to the global task centre. Check the final result before retrying. Office compatibility and performance require separate validation for your deployment.

data.name: help.notes.body
data.value:
This example stores one shared local note of at most 2000 characters. It is not a private notebook or cross-device sync service. Save with the button or Ctrl+S. The details panel shows saved text, not uncommitted input.
Reload first asks about unsaved changes. A failed save keeps your text. If the note changed elsewhere, keep a copy of your input, reload and retry. Wait for a running save to finish before closing. The note is included in the application database backup.

data.name: help.remoteDemo.body
data.value:
This page reads and writes the configured remote API. Search, sorting and paging happen on the server; local sample records and local backups are separate. Apply search and sorting with the button.
Code and name are required. Save and delete require permission and production confirmation when applicable. A version conflict keeps your input: preserve it, cancel, refresh and select the latest record. A timeout or account change does not prove a write was rolled back. Verify the server result before retrying.
Signing out or changing account clears old remote data. Sign in and refresh to load your account's data. The server must enforce its own permissions, uniqueness and concurrency rules.
